name: Tier List Studio
summary: A free tier list maker in your browser: drag in your own images, snap or place them freely, add notes and export a PNG.

distribution.label: Download app ZIP
distribution.scope: The whole editor as one index.html file plus the licence. No preview media or translations.

installation.title: Open it in your browser
installation.body: The editor runs straight from GitHub Pages. Nothing to install or sign up for.
installation.label: Open Tier List Studio

installation.title: Or run it from the download
installation.body: Download the ZIP from the release, extract it and open index.html in Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari. You can also clone main, which holds only the app.
installation.label: Release v1.0.0

installation.title: Make your list
installation.body: Drop or paste images, drag them into tiers, double-click an item to add a note under it, adjust the look in Design, then Export PNG or Copy image.

manual_setup: A recent browser. An internet connection when opening it, for Google Fonts and the html2canvas export library loaded from cdnjs.
Lists are autosaved in the browser's own storage. Save a project file (.json) to move a list to another device.
notes: Images stay on the device; nothing is uploaded.
Snapping can be turned off to place items anywhere inside a tier; hold Alt while dragging to flip it for one move.

image.alt: A tier grid with one tile being dropped into an empty slot
